families.label: Commerce Baseline
families.description: E-commerce dataset with users, products, orders, payments, and activity logs for SQL learning labs.

tables.name: users
tables.label: Users
tables.description: Registered customers who place orders on the platform. Includes a low-cardinality status column (active, inactive, suspended, pending) for index and bitmap scan labs.

tables.name: orders
tables.label: Orders
tables.description: Purchase orders linking users to products — primary table for pagination and index labs.

tables.name: payments
tables.label: Payments
tables.description: Payment records associated with completed orders.

tables.name: logs
tables.label: Activity Logs
tables.description: User activity events such as page views and actions.
